name: Maximum Sum Of M Non-overlapping Subarrays
statement:
1. You are given an array(arr) of positive numbers and two numbers M and K.
2. You have to find the maximum sum of M non-overlapping subarrays of size K.
3. The size of the given array(arr) is greater than M*K.
inputFormat:
A number N
arr1
arr2.. N numbers
Two numbers M and K
outputFormat: A number representing maximum sum of M non-overlapping subarrays of size K.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^3
1 <= arr[i] <= 10^3
M >= 1
K >= 1
N >= M*K
